mediaUploadDialog.title: Upload media
mediaUploadDialog.description: Videos and images. Files upload straight to storage and are processed in the background — you can close this dialog once they are queued.
mediaUploadDialog.queuedFiles: {n} files queued for processing | {n} file queued for processing | {n} files queued for processing

quality.label: Video quality
quality.hint: Applies to video uploads. High keeps 1080p for native-player boxes.

unclaimedDevicesTray.title: Unclaimed devices
unclaimedDevicesTray.allClaimedDescription: Devices that self-register will appear here.
unclaimedDevicesTray.claimValidation: Enter a name and pick a group

devices.pageSubtitle: Every screen across your network, with live status.
devices.emptyDescription: Adjust filters, or wait for devices to self-register.
devices.deleteConfirmDescription: Removes this device record. The APK on the TV will re-register on next boot.
devices.playlistSectionDescription: Overrides group- and address-level assignment for this device only. Clear to fall back to inherited.
devices.effectivePlaylistNone: No playlist resolves for this device — the screen stays blank.
devices.applyingSurface: Applying {surface}… (waiting for the box to report back)
devices.surfaceConfirmDescription: The player restarts on the box. Rollback is switching back — no OTA.
devices.otaConfirmDescription: The device will download and silently install the APK.
devices.rebootConfirmDescription: Restarts the whole box. Without device-owner provisioning the box cannot reboot itself, so it falls back to reloading the player.

addresses.pageSubtitle: Physical locations. Each address can contain multiple groups.
addresses.emptyDescription: Create your first address to start organizing devices.
addresses.deleteConfirmDescription: Removes this address and cascades to all groups. Devices in those groups will become unclaimed.
addresses.playlistSectionDescription: The fallback for every group and device at this address. Groups and devices override it with their own assignment.
addresses.effectivePlaylistNone: No playlist assigned — devices here stay blank unless their group or the device itself is assigned one.
addresses.noGroupsDescription: Groups subdivide an address. A clinic might have 'Lobby' and 'Cafeteria' groups.

groups.pageSubtitle: Zones inside an address — a clinic's Lobby and Cafeteria, say.
groups.emptyDescription: Create groups from an address detail page.
groups.playlistSectionDescription: Applies to every device in this group unless the device has its own direct assignment. Overrides the address-level assignment.
groups.effectivePlaylistNone: No playlist resolves here — devices in this group stay blank unless assigned directly.
groups.noDevicesDescription: Devices self-register and appear as unclaimed. Claim them from Overview or the Devices list.
groups.deleteConfirmDescription: Devices in this group will become unclaimed (their group_id will be set to null).

playlists.pageSubtitle: Ordered lists of media that TVs loop. Assign to a device, group, or address.
playlists.emptyDescription: Create a playlist and add media items to it.
playlists.deleteConfirmDescription: Removes this playlist and all its items. Assignments to this playlist will also be removed.
playlists.mediaLibraryHint: Click a tile to append it to the playlist.
playlists.emptyPlaylistDescription: Pick media from the left panel to add items.

media.pageSubtitle: Upload videos and images. Playlists reference media from this library.
media.emptyDescription: Upload videos or images to start building playlists.
media.deleteConfirmUsed: This file is used in {n} playlists. Deleting will remove those entries and bump each playlist version. | This file is used in {n} playlist. Deleting will remove those entries and bump each playlist version. | This file is used in {n} playlists. Deleting will remove those entries and bump each playlist version.
media.deleteConfirmUnused: Removes the file and its thumbnail permanently.
media.renameHint: Display name only — the stored file is unchanged.

users.pageSubtitle: Create admins and client accounts. Clients see only their organization's portal.
users.pickOrgForClient: Pick an organization for the client
users.deleteConfirmDescription: Their sessions end immediately. This cannot be undone.
users.accountCreatedBody: Share this one-time password with {email}. It is shown only once — they can change it later via "Forgot password".
users.copyFailedDescription: Select and copy the password manually.
users.resetConfirmDescription: A new password is generated and shown once. The user is signed out everywhere and must use the new password.
users.passwordResetBody: {email} has been signed out everywhere. Give them this password — it is not shown again.
users.cannotEditSelf: You cannot change your own role or organization.
users.roleChangeClearsOrg: Admins are not tied to an organization, so this clears it.

organizations.pageSubtitle: Companies that own media. Client accounts see stats for their org.
organizations.notesPlaceholder: Billing contact, contract terms, anything worth remembering…
organizations.mediaCount: no media | 1 media file | {n} media files
organizations.deleteConfirmEmpty: Nothing is attached to it, so this only removes the organization.
organizations.deleteConfirmAttached: {media} and {users} are attached. The media stays but loses its owner — the client accounts are deleted with the organization.
organizations.invalidEmail: That email address doesn't look valid.

portal.subtitle: Reach of your content across the network.
portal.emptyMedia: No media assigned to your organization yet.

overview.subtitle: Your signage network at a glance.

auth.googleFailed: Google sign-in failed, or no Lanka account for that address
auth.heroSubtitle: Monitor, group, and program every display across your network — from one quiet control plane.
auth.provisionNote: Lanka signage control plane · access is provisioned by your administrator.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a reset link.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for one hour.
auth.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Redirecting to sign in…
auth.resetLinkMissing: This reset link is missing or malformed. Request a new one.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
